---
name: RFC proposal
about: Suggest a technical direction for public review before writing a formal RFC
title: "RFC idea: "
---

## Problem to solve

What is not working, or which assumption should be reconsidered?

## Proposed approach

A brief description of the potential direction. This need not be a final design.

## Why UOE?

How does this relate to universal execution, AI-native engineering, the capability model, or living system knowledge?

## Alternatives and counterarguments

What are credible alternatives? What would make your idea unnecessary or mistaken?

## Evidence / prior art

Citations, concrete examples, versions, measurements or reproducible observations. Mark hypotheses as hypotheses.

## Experiment or decision needed

What could UOE test? What result would count against the proposal?

## Contributor provenance (optional)

Was this substantially AI-assisted? Who is the accountable submitter, if known?

## Next step

Discuss here, or submit a draft RFC with [the template](https://github.com/Ravenmoray/universal-operating-environment/blob/main/docs/rfcs/TEMPLATE.md). Do not interpret issue creation as acceptance.
